architecture: Validated shipment JSONL ingestion with duplicate and schema checks
BM25-style lexical plus TF-IDF cosine hybrid retrieval
Deterministic intent router and read-only shipment lookup
Source-cited answers and abstention when evidence is missing
Prompt-injection input checks and email/phone redaction
Structured trace for tool routing and safety events

evaluation.note: These are local smoke metrics with manually labelled synthetic cases, not the RAGAS package and not a production-quality evaluation.

limitations: Rule-based prompt injection and PII checks can miss patterns.
Lexical retrieval can miss semantic paraphrases.
All sources and shipments are fictional.
